dedupe_keys.name: asg eupos national gnss positioning system of poland

description: ASG-EUPOS is the Polish national system supporting satellite measurements and navigation, launched by the Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography in 2008 and described as a key state system for the country's investment processes. It provides real-time network RTK corrections (RTN), single-station RTK corrections, decimetre-level DGNSS corrections, post-processing services for GNSS measurements, and a service for downloading GNSS observation files from its reference stations, with NTRIP caster settings given on the home page. Since 2 October 2022 all ASG-EUPOS services are free of charge and available to registered users; the page counted 49,123 registered users and lists system messages, such as a new reference station in August 2026 and service interruptions. No licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the site is in Polish, and use requires registration. Coverage is Poland. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, including the dependence of surveying and construction on GNSS and the effects of space weather on positioning; related records are CZEPOS of the Czech Republic, SAPOS of Germany and SWEPOS of Sweden.
